name: Duck Hunters 2

features.name: Scatter wins
features.description: Eight or more matching symbols anywhere.

review:
A 5x6 scatter-pays sequel: eight or more matching symbols anywhere win and drop away. xWays reveal a paying symbol and double, quadruple or octuple the multiplier on their spot, and infectious xWays spread it further.

Bombs go off once no wins are left, clearing the area around them. If you like position-multiplier tumble games, this is Nolimit's version. Extreme volatility, 40,000x max, 96% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
